chapters.label: The press
chapters.text: Atlanta, 2025: the Club World Cup. Paris play Inter Miami, and João Neves never stops running. Busquets gets the ball… Paris press him fast. Ball won!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Paris close Busquets down the moment the ball arrives. Too quick for him… robbed! And Neves keeps running.

chapters.label: The goal
chapters.text: Ruiz rolls it across, and Neves side-foots into an empty net. Two–nil! Paris won four–nil, and Neves was player of the match.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s João Neves. When you lose the ball, press quickly: the first few seconds are best to win it back!
